name: Salu
title: Simeonite leader
summary: Salu was a leader from the tribe of Simeon and the father of Zimri, who was killed by Phinehas for bringing a Midianite woman into the camp of Israel. Salu is best known through his son Zimri's sin at Baal-Peor, an event that led to a severe plague among the Israelites.

keyEvents.title: Zimri's sin at Baal-Peor
keyEvents.description: Salu's son Zimri brought the Midianite woman Kozbi into the camp of Israel in the midst of the people's mourning over the plague, which was an open sin against God.

keyEvents.title: Salu identified as a Simeonite leader
keyEvents.description: Salu is mentioned as a leader among one of the family heads in the tribe of Simeon, showing that Zimri's sin was especially serious given his family's prominent position.

keyEvents.title: Phinehas' zealous action
keyEvents.description: The priest Phinehas killed Zimri son of Salu and the Midianite woman Kozbi with a spear, thereby stopping the plague that had struck Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Plague Stops
keyEvents.description: As a result of Phinehas' action, God's wrath was turned away from the people of Israel, but 24,000 people had already died in the plague that was triggered by idolatry at Baal-Peor.

keyEvents.title: God's Covenant with Phinehas
keyEvents.description: Because of Phinehas' zeal against the sin committed by, among others, the son of Salus, God gave Phinehas an eternal covenant of peace and an eternal priesthood.
